svg.aria-label: A tilted office building teeters on a cracked, plunging line chart on the left. A calm human figure stands between the two scenes. On the right, three small robots march out of a doorway, each carrying a different item: a bank card, a suitcase, and a phone. The label "Business As Usual" reads above.
